story: Ask HN: Which plants can be planted indoors and easily maintained?
text: Here is the list of house/indoor plants which promote cognitive function in order of ease of maintenance: Areca Plam (Chrysalidocarpus lutescens AKA Dypsis lutescens) [LINK] Mother-in-law's Tongue / Snake Plant (Sansevieria trifasciata) [LINK] Money Plant (Epipremnum aureum) [LINK] Boston Fern (Nephrolepis Exaltata) [LINK] Peace Lilly (Spathiphyllum) [LINK] Gerbera Daisy (Gerbera jamesonii) [LINK] Spider plant (Chlorophytum comosum) [LINK] English Ivy (Hedera helix) [LINK] Take the list of plants to your local plant nursery to see how many of them they have in stock. Buying them already established is much cheaper/easier than growing them from seed/cuttings. According to Allen et Al 2015 (see link below), having pure/fresh air in your working environment significantly improves cognitive function. i.e. having indoor plants makes you smarter! > Associations of Cognitive Function Scores with Carbon Dioxide, Ventilation, and Volatile Organic Compound Exposures in Office Workers: A Controlled Exposure Study of Green and Conventional Office Environments ~ [LINK] > Conclusion : Office workers had significantly improved cognitive function scores when working in Green and Green+ environments compared with scores obtained when working in a Conventional environment. > We’ve been researching this for: “home” [LINK] Relevant YouTube videos on this topic: [VIDEO] [LINK] [LINK]
